cuzdan.aciklama: Pay an advance to the agency and settle your invoices from this balance, in full or in part.
cuzdan.bakiyeYok: You have no balance yet. Start by topping up.

hukuki.metin: Your balance is an advance paid only for the agency's own services. It is not a means of payment to third parties or electronic money; it bears no interest and cannot be transferred to anyone else. Any unused balance is refunded on request.
hukuki.not: For information only; this is not legal advice.

yukle.adimlar: 1) Send a bank transfer to the account below and add your code to the description. 2) Report the amount and the receipt. 3) Once approved, the amount is added to your balance.
yukle.bankaYok: The agency has not entered its bank details yet. You can still send your notice; contact the agency for payment details.
yukle.referansIpucu: Write this code in the transfer description so your payment is matched to your account.
yukle.dekontIpucu: Attaching the receipt speeds up approval.
yukle.gonderildi: Your notice was received. It will be added to your balance once approved.

ayarlar.otomatik: Pay my new invoices automatically from my balance
ayarlar.onayMetni: Once you turn this on, new invoices issued to you are paid automatically from your balance in the same currency. The amount paid is recorded on the invoice and you are notified. You can turn it off at any time; invoices issued earlier are not paid automatically.
ayarlar.kismi: If the balance is not enough, apply what is available (if off, nothing is applied and you are notified)
ayarlar.esikIpucu: You are notified once when your balance falls below this amount. Leave empty to turn the alert off.
ayarlar.acik: Automatic payment is on (invoices issued since {{tarih}})

ode.tekrar: This payment had already been made.

odemeSayfasi.aciklama: You have a balance of {{tutar}} on your account.

yonetim.aciklama: Client advances: manual top-ups, notices awaiting approval, ledger, refunds and adjustments. Entries are never deleted; mistakes are corrected with a reversal.
yonetim.duzeltmeIpucu: Positive or negative amount; a reason is required.
yonetim.bankaIpucu: Empty fields fall back to the company name and IBAN under Invoices › Agency details.
yonetim.muhasebeNotu: Bookkeeping: a top-up is a bank/cash inflow (client advance, not income); paying from the balance is invoice income (no cash movement); a refund is a cash outflow (not an expense); adjustments arrive as suggestions.

hata.genel: The action could not be completed.
hata.para_birimi_uyusmuyor: There is no balance in this invoice's currency (no currency conversion).
hata.tutar_kalandan_fazla: The amount exceeds the invoice balance due.

hata.fatura_taslak: A draft invoice cannot be paid.
hata.iade_faturasi: A credit note cannot be paid.
hata.neden_gerekli: A reason for declining is required.
hata.talep_beklemede_degil: This notice is no longer pending.
hata.cok_fazla_bekleyen: You have too many notices awaiting approval.
hata.zaten_ters_cevrildi: This entry has already been reversed.
